install_deps.description: Installs the tools in editable mode with their dependencies and the test runner. Run this when imports fail with ModuleNotFoundError.

list_packages.description: Lists the installed Python packages and their versions.

python_version.description: Shows the Python version used to run the tools and the tests.

python_doc.description: Shows the documentation and signatures of an installed module, class or function. Use it to check a library's API instead of guessing it. Argument: the full name (e.g., 'mcp.server.mcpserver.MCPServer' or 'pathlib.Path').

run_tests.description: Runs the whole test suite. Use this to verify changes before considering a task done.

run_test_file.description: Runs the tests of one file, or one test, which is faster than the whole suite while working on a change. Argument: the test file or test (e.g., 'tests/test_commands.py' or 'tests/test_commands.py::test_list_available_commands').

run_tests_matching.description: Runs the tests whose names match an expression. Argument: part of the test names, optionally with and/or/not (e.g., 'registry' or 'registry and not broken').

run_failed_tests.description: Runs again only the tests that failed in the previous test run. Use it to check a fix.
